plan_title: OBS Video Recording to Summarized Notes Conversion Project
goal: Develop a Python-based system to process OBS .mkv video recordings with multiple audio tracks, converting them into summarized meeting notes. The system should separate audio tracks, transcribe them using Whisper, align the transcripts, and generate a concise summary. This project aims to automate the creation of meeting notes from video recordings, improving efficiency and accessibility of information from recorded sessions.
context: This project utilizes various libraries and AI models, including ffmpeg for audio processing, Whisper for transcription, and language models for summarization. The workflow is implemented in a Jupyter notebook environment, allowing for interactive development and testing.

workplan.title: Set up the development environment
tasks: Create and activate the Conda environment using the Makefile
Install required packages
Configure Jupyter Lab

workplan.title: Create a Jupyter notebook for video processing
tasks: Import necessary libraries
Define helper functions for file handling

workplan.title: Implement audio track separation
tasks: Use ffmpeg-python to extract audio tracks from .mkv file
Save microphone and desktop audio as separate files

workplan.title: Transcribe audio tracks
tasks: Use Whisper to transcribe microphone audio
Use Whisper to transcribe desktop audio
Save transcriptions with timestamps

workplan.title: Align and combine transcripts
tasks: Implement a function to merge transcripts based on timestamps
Create a combined, coherent transcript

workplan.title: Summarize the transcript
tasks: Use a language model (e.g., OpenAI or Anthropic) to summarize the transcript
Generate a concise meeting report

workplan.title: Test the workflow
tasks: Obtain a sample OBS .mkv recording
Run the entire process on the sample video
Verify output at each stage

workplan.title: Optimize and refine
tasks: Identify any performance bottlenecks
Refine the summarization prompt for better results
Add error handling and logging
